en_US: Build your body from monster bones
The skull Bonesy woke up with. No frills.
An honest rib cage. Protects the emptiness inside.
Stacking poison: every hit adds a dose.
Shield of 15% HP at the start of combat
I built a %s in Bone Tribe! Can you build something worse?
Three skeleton rats are fighting over a petrified cheese. They stop and stare at you.
You tiptoe past. The cheese matters more than you do.
One rat decides you look petrified too. And tasty.
A witch offers a glowing bone in exchange for half your life. Accept or refuse?
The witch shrugs and tucks the bone into her hat. 'Your loss, sweetie.'
A chest creaks all by itself. It could be treasure. It could be a hungry mimic.
Treasure! The creak was just the hinge complaining about life.
The chest opens its mouth. It has teeth. Lots of teeth.
You leave the chest creaking alone. It looks offended.
A howl rolls through the tombs. The Crypt Wolf sniffs for your marrow, which you don't even have.
The wolf walks right by. The sarcophagus owner grumbles but lets you stay.
The sarcophagus lid creaks. The wolf grins. With every tooth.
Thick webs seal the corridor. Something with eight legs descends slowly, smiling with its fangs.
Your new legs know the way. The web becomes a shortcut, and the spider claps with four hands.
A Vampire Bat sleeps upside down, snoring softly. It smells of old blood.
Not a single bone creaks. A skeletal miracle.
Your knee pops. The bat wakes up. And calls its cousin.
The sand of an old tomb shifts. A curved tail rises, dripping something green.
A Corpse Bear hibernates on a pile of bones. Some of them look useful.
You rest a little to the sound of snoring. Strangely comforting.
Bones crack in the dark. Something is sniffing along your trail.
A gambling skeleton rattles knucklebone dice. 'Double or nothing on your bone dust?'
The dice land on six. The gambler nearly loses his jaw laughing.
The dice land on one. 'The house always wins, partner.'
'Coward!' he shouts, and goes back to betting with a rat.
A murky fountain bubbles. They say whoever drinks gets stronger… or softer.
The water runs down your ribs and hardens your bones. You feel sturdy.
The water tasted like swamp. Your bones go wobbly for a while.
Better not. You don't even have a stomach.
A coffin shakes. Inside, something knocks three times, politely.
Nobody home, just a fine bone waiting for a new owner.
Inside, only bone dust. Lots of bone dust.
It was two skeleton rats playing ghost. They don't find you funny.
The knocking stops. Then starts again, a little offended.
At the end of the crypt, on a throne of cheese and bones, the Rat King raises his crown. 'Kneel… ah, you have no knees.'

A pile of stones rises, grinding blue runes. The Forgotten Golem can't remember who it is, but it remembers how to crush.
The air grows hot. Huge bones uncoil in the dark and two eyes light up like embers. The Ancient Dragon woke up grumpy.
From the Dragon's ashes, three necks rise. Each head argues with the others about who gets to bite you first.
Your Bone Wyrm's fire called something ancient. The floor shakes. The crypt has one more floor.
